deviations.what: Criterion 'every ON run writes 300 frames' was replaced by 'exactly floor(steps_run / 2) frames'.
deviations.cause: run_policy_episode stops at success, so a successful episode has fewer than 600 steps; continuing after success would change trajectory_sha256.
deviations.when: Agreed with piperobot-e5 on 2026-11-04 at 12:30 -05:00, before any camera run.

deviations.what: code_commit is the pose-freeze commit 1d419c0, not the first commit that adds recording (6298db3).
deviations.cause: At piperobot-e5's suggestion the recording code was committed first and the camera pose was frozen in a second commit after framing; both arms ran at 1d419c0, and neither commit changes the recording-off path.

consequences: The gate's video job can re-run judged seeds with the camera and keep a runtime check that the rerun's trajectory_sha256 matches the judged one.

Host commit, not GPU memory, limits camera runs: one camera worker peaks at ~13-15 GiB of commit. The video job needs a free-commit preflight (about 19 GiB: the cold 14.9 GiB peak plus 25%) and skips recording with a warning below it.
An OFF worker peaks at 6.6 GiB of commit, so two evaluate workers need about 13.2 GiB plus a margin; evaluate's two-worker decision should check free commit as well as VRAM.
